query_sql_oneshot_error_trigger_sub_quer.statement: SELECT COUNT_DISTINCT(cleient_ip) AS "Client IP" FROM security_event WHERE ((security_action = 'Deny')) AND recv_time >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2024-03-12T00:00:00+08:00') AND recv_time < UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2024-03-12T23:59:59+08:00') AND security_event.vsys_id IN (1) ORDER BY "Client IP" DESC LIMIT 20
